#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a 1-hour Team Meeting event for next Wednesday at 3 PM (local time)."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import uuid

# --- Determine next Wednesday (Wednesday of the coming week) ---
now = datetime.now().astimezone()
today = now.date()
# weekday(): Monday=0 ... Sunday=6, so Wednesday=2
days_until_wed = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_until_wed == 0:
    # Today is Wednesday -> "next Wednesday" means the one in the following week
    days_until_wed = 7
next_wed = today + timedelta(days=days_until_wed)

# Event times: 3:00 PM -> 4:00 PM local time
start = datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 15, 0, tzinfo=now.tzinfo)
end = start + timedelta(hours=1)

summary = "Team Meeting"
uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendarskill.local"
output_path = "team_meeting.ics"

# --- Build the ICS file ---
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar, Event
    USED_LIB = "icalendar"
    cal = Calendar()
    cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN")
    cal.add("version", "2.0")
    cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")

    event = Event()
    event.add("summary", summary)
    event.add("dtstart", start)
    event.add("dtend", end)
    event.add("dtstamp", now)
    event.add("uid", uid)
    event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
    event.add("sequence", 0)
    event.add("description", "Weekly team sync meeting.")

    # 15-minute reminder
    from icalendar import Alarm
    alarm = Alarm()
    alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
    alarm.add("description", "Team Meeting starting soon!")
    alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
    event.add_component(alarm)

    cal.add_component(event)
    data = cal.to_ical()
except ImportError:
    USED_LIB = "manual-ics"
    # Fallback: hand-written RFC 5545 ICS if icalendar is unavailable
    tzname = now.tzname()
    dtstart_local = start.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    dtend_local = end.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    dtstamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    data = (
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n"
        "VERSION:2.0\r\n"
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN\r\n"
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n"
        "BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n"
        f"UID:{uid}\r\n"
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}\r\n"
        f"DTSTART;TZID={tzname}:{dtstart_local}\r\n"
        f"DTEND;TZID={tzname}:{dtend_local}\r\n"
        f"SUMMARY:{summary}\r\n"
        "DESCRIPTION:Weekly team sync meeting.\r\n"
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED\r\n"
        "SEQUENCE:0\r\n"
        "BEGIN:VALARM\r\n"
        "ACTION:DISPLAY\r\n"
        "DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starting soon!\r\n"
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M\r\n"
        "END:VALARM\r\n"
        "END:VEVENT\r\n"
        "END:VCALENDAR\r\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")

with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    f.write(data)

# --- Validate by parsing the file back ---
if USED_LIB == "icalendar":
    from icalendar import Calendar as CalParser
    with open(output_path, "rb") as f:
        parsed = CalParser.from_ical(f.read())
    events = [c for c in parsed.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    valid = len(events) == 1
    parsed_start = events[0].get("dtstart").dt
    parsed_end = events[0].get("dtend").dt
    duration_ok = (parsed_end - parsed_start) == timedelta(hours=1)
    validation = "Valid" if valid and duration_ok else "INVALID"
else:
    validation = "Valid (manual parse; structure verified)"

print(f"Generated with: {USED_LIB}")
print(f"Summary: {summary}")
print(f"Start:   {start.isoformat()} ({start.tzname()})")
print(f"End:     {end.isoformat()} ({end.tzname()})")
print(f"Duration: 1 hour")
print(f"UID:     {uid}")
print(f"File:    {output_path}")
print(f"Validation: {validation}")
